text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
reflection: What hurt you was real, and it was wrong. Yet God can weave even this wound into a story of good you cannot see yet.

text: The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.
reflection: You don't have to fight this battle in your own strength. Let God stand in front of what overwhelms you while you simply rest.

text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
reflection: A broken heart can make you feel abandoned. God promises the opposite: He walks right beside you and will never leave.

text: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms.
reflection: When everything gives way, you don't fall into nothing. His everlasting arms are underneath you, holding you up.

text: Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
reflection: Naomi was honest about her bitterness, and God did not turn away from her. You can be honest too; your story isn't over.

text: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept sore.
reflection: Hannah brought her tears straight to God. You don't need tidy words; your weeping can be your prayer.

text: Man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.
reflection: Others may only see the surface, but God sees your heart, every hidden ache, and He looks on it with love.

text: In my distress I called on the LORD. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple.
reflection: Your cry does not disappear into silence. Even from the depths of distress, God hears your voice.

text: I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you.
reflection: Not one of your tears has gone unnoticed. The God who sees them is also the God who heals.

text: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
reflection: God does not leave the wounded where they fell. His hands bind up what is broken and make it whole again.

text: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at last he will stand upon the earth.
reflection: In the middle of unbearable loss, Job held on to this: his Redeemer lives. That hope is still yours today.

text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come out like gold.
reflection: God knows the road you are walking, even the parts that feel like fire. You will come through, refined like gold.

text: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
reflection: It's okay to admit you are faint and worn out. Ask for mercy; God is gentle with hearts that are tired.

text: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
reflection: Even the psalmist cried himself to sleep. Your tears are not weakness, and God has made room for them.

text: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
reflection: Your prayer has been heard and received. Rest in knowing God has accepted every word you have brought Him.

text: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed, a high tower in times of trouble.
reflection: When life presses hard, God is a high tower, a safe place to run to and hide.

text: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear.
reflection: God listens closely to humble, hurting hearts. He is already preparing yours to receive His comfort.

text: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
reflection: 'How long?' is a prayer God welcomes. You can bring Him your questions as well as your trust.

text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
reflection: Even while you wait for answers, you can lean on His unfailing love. Joy is still possible on the other side.

text: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice.
reflection: When you call out in distress, your voice reaches God. He hears you, every time.

text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
reflection: God never looks away from your pain. When you cry out, He does not hide His face. He hears.

text: The LORD is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul.
reflection: Let the Shepherd lead you to quiet places. He knows how to restore a soul that feels emptied out.

text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
reflection: This valley is real, but you are not walking it alone. The Shepherd is with you, every step.

text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
reflection: When you feel desolate, you can ask God to turn toward you. He meets the lonely and the afflicted with mercy.

text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
reflection: Hold on to this confidence: you will still see God's goodness, not only someday, but here in this life.

text: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
reflection: Waiting is hard when your heart is hurting. Be strong one small moment at a time, and wait for the Lord.

text: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
reflection: The psalmist cried out and was healed. Bring your broken heart to God, the One who restores.

text: Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
reflection: This night of weeping will not last forever. Morning is coming, and with it, joy.

text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness.
reflection: God specializes in turning mourning into dancing. Trust Him to bring gladness back into your life.

text: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye is consumed with grief. Yes, my soul and my body.
reflection: Grief can wear down both body and soul. God's mercy reaches every part of you that hurts.

text: I said in my haste, ‘I am cut off from before your eyes.’ Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
reflection: Even when you feel cut off from God, He is still listening. Your feelings are not the final word.

text: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
reflection: God hears the cry of His people and delivers them. Your troubles do not have the last say.

text: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
reflection: God draws closest when your heart is breaking. You are not too broken for His nearness.

text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
reflection: Life can bring many afflictions, but none of them is bigger than God's power to carry you through.

text: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
reflection: Every sigh and longing is already known to God. Nothing in your heart is hidden from His care.

text: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay.
reflection: God hears your cry and lifts you from the pit. In time, He will set your feet on solid ground again.

text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, ‘Where is your God?’
reflection: Some days tears feel like your only food. God does not shame your sorrow; He stays with you in it.

text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I will still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
reflection: Speak gently to your own downcast soul: hope in God. Praise will rise again.

text: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song will be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.
reflection: By day His love is near, and by night His song is with you. You are held around the clock.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reflection: When trouble comes, God is not far away. He is your refuge and strength, present right now.

text: Be still, and know that I am God.
reflection: Let your striving heart be quiet for a moment. Be still, and remember who God is.

text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me.
reflection: Even the faithful have felt crushed by fear and pain. Your anguish is not a sign that God has left you.

text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you.
reflection: This burden is too heavy for you to carry alone. Cast it on the Lord; He will sustain you.

text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?
reflection: God keeps track of every tear you cry. Your pain is precious to Him, and none of it is forgotten.

text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
reflection: When your heart is overwhelmed, ask God to lead you to the Rock that stands higher than your pain.

text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
reflection: Find rest in God alone. He is your rock and fortress, and with Him you will not be shaken for good.

text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
reflection: Pour out your whole heart before Him: the anger, the sorrow, the questions. God is a safe refuge for all of it.

text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
reflection: God has helped you before, and He is helping you now. Rest in the shadow of His wings.

text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck. I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold.
reflection: When it feels like you're sinking with nothing to stand on, cry out like the psalmist. God hears desperate prayers.

text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, will let me live. You will bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
reflection: The God who allowed you to see hard days will also restore your life and bring you up from the depths again.

text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
reflection: When your heart and strength fail, God remains the strength of your heart, forever.

text: My voice is to God, and I will cry out; my voice is to God, and he will hear me. In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord.
reflection: In your day of trouble, keep crying out to God. He hears you, even when the night feels long.

text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
reflection: Call on God in your trouble with confidence. He will answer you.

text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
reflection: God is merciful and gracious, slow to anger and overflowing with love. That is how He looks at you right now.

text: LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you. Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.
reflection: Some prayers come from a very dark place. God makes room for honest lament, and He keeps listening day and night.

text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
reflection: When your thoughts spin with worry and grief, His comfort can still bring your soul delight.

text: Hear my prayer, LORD. Let my cry come to you. Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress.
reflection: You can ask God plainly not to hide from you in your distress. He hears the prayers of the hurting.

text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
reflection: Like a tender father, God feels compassion for you. He knows your pain and treats you gently.

text: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
reflection: God bends down to listen to you. Because He hears, you can keep calling on Him for as long as you live.

text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the name of the LORD.
reflection: When sorrow and trouble wrapped around him, the psalmist called on God's name. You can do the same today.

text: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
reflection: Let your soul return to rest. God has been good to you before, and He will be good to you again.

text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
reflection: God delivers souls from death, eyes from tears, and feet from stumbling. He is working your rescue too.

text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
reflection: In seasons of affliction, God's Word can breathe new life into you. Let it be your comfort today.

text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
reflection: Ask God to let His unfailing love be your comfort, just as He has promised.

text: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word. My eyes fail for your word. I say, ‘When will you comfort me?’
reflection: Waiting for comfort can be exhausting. Keep hoping in His Word; His comfort is on its way.

text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
reflection: Trouble and anguish may surround you, but God's Word can still be a source of delight and steadiness.

text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
reflection: The tears you are sowing now are not wasted. One day you will reap with songs of joy.

text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD. Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
reflection: No depth is too deep for God to hear you. Cry out from wherever you are.

text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me.
reflection: Even in the middle of trouble, God preserves your life and revives your heart.

text: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell my trouble before him. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my way.
reflection: When your spirit grows faint, God still knows your way. Tell Him everything that troubles you.

text: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me. Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you.
reflection: Ask God to let you hear of His unfailing love in the morning. Tomorrow can begin with His kindness.

text: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
reflection: God is near to everyone who calls on Him in truth. You only need to call.

text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
reflection: God heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds. He is tending to yours with great care.

text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
reflection: When nothing makes sense, you don't have to understand it all. Trust God; He will make your path straight.

text: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its joy.
reflection: Others may not fully understand your bitterness, but God knows your heart completely.

text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
reflection: A crushed spirit drains you of life. Ask God to slowly restore your cheer, one small joy at a time.

text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
reflection: This is a season to weep and mourn, and that's okay. A time to laugh and dance will come again.

text: He has swallowed up death forever; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces.
reflection: One day God will wipe the tears from every face. Your sorrow has an ending.

text: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.
reflection: Hear God's tender words to His people: 'Comfort, comfort.' He wants to comfort you today.

text: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom.
reflection: Like a shepherd, God gathers the hurting lambs into His arms and carries them close to His heart.

text: But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
reflection: When grief leaves you weary, wait on the Lord. He will renew your strength to rise again.

text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you.
reflection: Don't fear, and don't be dismayed. God is with you, strengthening you and holding you up.

text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you.
reflection: The waters may be deep, but they will not sweep you away. God is with you in the flood.

text: He was despised, and rejected by men; a man of suffering, and acquainted with grief.
reflection: Jesus knows sorrow and grief firsthand. You are loved by a Savior who truly understands your pain.

text: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering.
reflection: Jesus carried our griefs and sorrows. You don't have to carry yours alone.

text: My loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed, says the LORD who has compassion on you.
reflection: Even if mountains shake, God's love for you will not be shaken. His promise of peace stands firm.

text: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble.
reflection: The Holy One draws near to the crushed and lowly in spirit, to revive and refresh them.

text: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me; because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted.
reflection: Jesus came to bind up the brokenhearted. Your healing is part of His mission.

text: To give to them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.
reflection: God can trade your ashes for beauty and your mourning for joy. Let Him begin the exchange.

text: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you.
reflection: As a mother comforts her child, so God comforts you: tenderly, patiently, closely.

text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
reflection: Even now, God's plans for you are for peace and a hopeful future. This pain is not the end.

text: I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
reflection: God promises to turn mourning into joy and to bring comfort and gladness in place of sorrow.

text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.
reflection: God sees your weary soul and promises to refresh and satisfy it.

text: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
reflection: Because of God's great love, you are not consumed. His mercies are brand new this morning.

text: For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he cause grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
reflection: Grief does not last forever. God's compassion and unfailing love will have the final word.

text: Come, and let us return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us.
reflection: Return to the Lord with your wounds. He is the One who heals and binds up.

text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
reflection: God is good, a strong refuge in the day of trouble, and He knows you when you run to Him.

text: The LORD your God is in the midst of you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love.
reflection: God is with you, mighty to save. He quiets you with His love and rejoices over you.

text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
reflection: Jesus calls those who mourn blessed, because comfort is coming to them. Your grief is seen.

text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
reflection: Come as you are, heavy and tired. Jesus is gentle and humble, and He will give your soul rest.

text: He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted.
reflection: Jesus was sent to heal the brokenhearted. Your broken heart is exactly what He came for.

text: Jesus wept.
reflection: Jesus wept. He does not stand far off from your grief; He enters it and weeps with you.

text: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
reflection: Don't let your heart be troubled. Trust in God, and trust in Jesus, who holds your life.

text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you... Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
reflection: Jesus gives a peace the world can't offer. Let His peace settle your troubled heart.

text: You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
reflection: Your sorrow is real, but Jesus promises it will be turned into joy.

text: In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
reflection: Trouble is part of life in this world, but Jesus has overcome it. Take heart.

text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
reflection: Today's sufferings are heavy, but they are not the whole story. Glory is coming that will outweigh them.

text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
reflection: God is at work in all things, even this, for the good of those who love Him.

text: ...nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
reflection: Nothing, not grief, loss, or heartbreak, can separate you from the love of God in Christ.

text: Blessed be... the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction.
reflection: God is the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort. He comforts you in every trouble.

text: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed.
reflection: You may be hard pressed, but you are not crushed. Struck down, but not destroyed. God holds you.

text: Therefore we don’t faint; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
reflection: Even as you feel worn down, God is renewing your inner self day by day. Don't lose heart.

text: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
reflection: Hand every worry and heartache to God. He cares for you deeply.

text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more.
reflection: One day there will be no more tears, death, sorrow, or pain. Hold on to that promise.
